summary.text: Jeff Chavez is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Cody Harris.
A former journalist and public school teacher, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his campaign centers on public education and protecting East Texas water.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Chavez earned a high school diploma from Palestine High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Dallas in 2013.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Chavez said he worked as an East Texas news reporter after college and then spent three years as a public school educator.
He described his family as rooted in East Texas since the mid-1960s and as the son of a Vietnam veteran and grandson of a World War II Merchant Marine.
Chavez advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, receiving 5,509 votes in an unopposed race.

In the survey, he listed education, equality and civil rights, and protecting East Texas water among his priorities; on education, he said he opposes the state's school voucher program, and on water he said he would seek to replace the "Rule of Capture" law with protections for East Texas landowners.
